candidates.name: undici
candidates.claim: GHSA-2jfj-6hjv-fm6j: shared caches could store and replay responses containing Set-Cookie, disclosing one user's cookies to another caller. Undici now excludes these responses from shared caches, including existing entries and revalidation paths. Fixed by cb75bbb3
